title: Blue Account: How overdraft transfer fees work
summary: Explains Blue Account overdraft protection transfer fees: if overdraft protection is enabled, the bank transfers from a linked account to cover a shortfall and charges $12.50 per transfer initiated. The $12.50 fee can apply even if the transfer covers only part of the shortfall.
